title: Applied AI Engineer (Remote)
description_html:
We build LLM-powered products and need an engineer who ships.

  • Integrate LLM (Anthropic/OpenAI) APIs into production features
  • Build RAG pipelines over customer data (vector DBs)
  • Own services end to end: FastAPI, Docker, CI/CD
  • Write evals to measure quality

Nice to have: TypeScript, Postgres.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description_html:
Embed with customers to build and deploy AI features on top of our platform.

  • 1+ year of software engineering (TypeScript/React/SQL)
  • Comfortable talking to customers and shipping fast
  • Bonus: LLM application experience, an active clearance

title: ML Platform Engineer
description_html:
Build the platform our ML teams deploy on.

  • Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD
  • Python tooling and infra
  • Model serving and monitoring

title: Senior ML Research Scientist
description_html:
Advance the state of the art in model training.

  • PhD in ML or related field
  • Publications at top venues (NeurIPS/ICML)
  • Train large models from scratch in PyTorch
